theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceGram_pi_matrix_det_ne_zero_iff {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {J : ι → Type u_5} [(i : ι) → Fintype (J i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (J i)] [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (J i)] :
((BilinForm.toMatrix (Pi.basis fun (i : ι) => Matrix.stdBasis K (J i) (J i))) (regTraceBilin K ((i : ι) → Matrix (J i) (J i) K))).det ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ (i : ι), ↑(Fintype.card (J i)) ≠ 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceGram_pi_matrix_det {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {J : ι → Type u_5} [(i : ι) → Fintype (J i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (J i)] :
((BilinForm.toMatrix (Pi.basis fun (i : ι) => Matrix.stdBasis K (J i) (J i))) (regTraceBilin K ((i : ι) → Matrix (J i) (J i) K))).det = ∏ i : ι, ↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign (Equiv.prodComm (J i) (J i))) * ↑(Fintype.card (J i)) ^ (Fintype.card (J i) * Fintype.card (J i))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceGram_pi_det' {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Ring (B i)] [(i : ι) → Algebra K (B i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (B i)] {κ : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → Fintype (κ i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)] (b : (i : ι) → Module.Basis (κ i) K (B i)) :
((BilinForm.toMatrix (Pi.basis b)) (regTraceBilin K ((i : ι) → B i))).det = ∏ i : ι, ((BilinForm.toMatrix (b i)) (regTraceBilin K (B i))).det

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceGram_pi_det {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Ring (B i)] [(i : ι) → Algebra K (B i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (B i)] {κ : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → Fintype (κ i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)] [LinearOrder ι] (b : (i : ι) → Module.Basis (κ i) K (B i)) :
((BilinForm.toMatrix (Pi.basis b)) (regTraceBilin K ((i : ι) → B i))).det = ∏ i : ι, ((BilinForm.toMatrix (b i)) (regTraceBilin K (B i))).det

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceGram_pi_diagonal {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Ring (B i)] [(i : ι) → Algebra K (B i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (B i)] {κ : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → Fintype (κ i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)] (b : (i : ι) → Module.Basis (κ i) K (B i)) (k : ι) :
(Matrix.of fun (a c : κ k) => (BilinForm.toMatrix (Pi.basis b)) (regTraceBilin K ((i : ι) → B i)) ⟨k, a⟩ ⟨k, c⟩) = (BilinForm.toMatrix (b k)) (regTraceBilin K (B k))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceGram_pi_offDiagonal {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Ring (B i)] [(i : ι) → Algebra K (B i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (B i)] {κ : ι → Type u_4} [(i : ι) → Fintype (κ i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)] (b : (i : ι) → Module.Basis (κ i) K (B i)) (p q : (i : ι) × κ i) (hpq : p.fst ≠ q.fst) :
(BilinForm.toMatrix (Pi.basis b)) (regTraceBilin K ((i : ι) → B i)) p q = 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceForm_pi_single_same {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Ring (B i)] [(i : ι) → Algebra K (B i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (B i)] (j : ι) (x y : B j) :
regTraceForm K ((i : ι) → B i) (Pi.single j x) (Pi.single j y) = regTraceForm K (B j) x y

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.regTraceForm_pi_single_of_ne {K : Type u_1} [Field K] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {B : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Ring (B i)] [(i : ι) → Algebra K (B i)] [∀ (i : ι), FiniteDimensional K (B i)] {j k : ι} (hjk : j ≠ k) (x : B j) (y : B k) :
regTraceForm K ((i : ι) → B i) (Pi.single j x) (Pi.single k y) = 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.det_blockDiagonal' {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] {κ : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Fintype (κ i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)] (M : (i : ι) → Matrix (κ i) (κ i) R) :
(Matrix.blockDiagonal' M).det = ∏ i : ι, (M i).det

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.det_eq_prod_of_offDiagonal_eq_zero {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [LinearOrder ι] {κ : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → Fintype (κ i)] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)] (M : Matrix ((i : ι) × κ i) ((i : ι) × κ i) R) (hoff : ∀ (p q : (i : ι) × κ i), p.fst ≠ q.fst → M p q = 0) :
M.det = ∏ i : ι, (Matrix.of fun (a b : κ i) => M ⟨i, a⟩ ⟨i, b⟩).det
